$comment: Waybar custom-module snippet for the Omarchy Soundboard. Stock Omarchy 4.x runs omarchy-shell (Quickshell) with the plugin's native QML widget; use this only if you run Waybar. Merge custom/soundboard into 'modules-left' or 'modules-right', append the CSS to style.css, then run bin/reload-waybar.sh. The icon glyph is defined once, in bin/sb-waybar-status.sh (SBOARD_ICON overrides it).
$notes: Waybar caches custom-module output when interval is 0. After editing the glyph/script, run bin/reload-waybar.sh — it sends SIGRTMIN+7 (re-exec the module) and SIGUSR2 (re-read config/style). Use --restart for a full daemon restart.
The GTK window is pinned/floated by the o.window rule in ~/.config/hypr/hyprland.lua; bin/toggle-soundboard.sh owns its lifecycle.
